$comment: Banned NCERT exercise references per board/year. Used by validateQuestionBanks CI script. Source: CBSE Class 10 Syllabus 2025-26 (cbseacademic.nic.in).

rules.subject: Maths
rules.reason: NCERT Ch 13 Ex 13.3 (Frustum of Cone) was deleted from the CBSE Class 10 syllabus from 2023-24 onwards. Note: Ex 11.1/11.2 and Ex 9.1/9.2 are NOT banned in new NCERT — chapter renumbering means Ch 9 = Some Applications of Trigonometry (RETAINED) and Ch 11 = Areas Related to Circles (RETAINED). Earlier inclusion of those exercises was a false positive surfaced during P2 SQP extraction (2026-05-24) and removed.
